_: Awkward layouts, read by tests/js/layout.test.js and by
tests/test_layout_agreement.py. Both normalisers run every one of these
and must agree, because both of them rewrite layout.json: the board
saves what it holds, the host normalises what it is sent, and a
disagreement means a tile saved in a shape the other side repairs
differently. Each case says what it is guarding.

cases.why: the old flat tile, which is what every upgrade starts from
a stack, which must pass through untouched
an active naming a card that is not here; the board would draw an empty box under a working tab strip
a tile with nothing in it is not a tile
a card with no id goes, its siblings stay
two cards sharing a uid would share their settings and their identity through the proxy
junk geometry falls back rather than reaching the grid as NaN
fields nobody declared are dropped, so a hand-edit cannot smuggle one past
popped is a boolean whatever it was written as
a whole board, mixed shapes, which is what an upgrade actually looks like
